加州司法部写明：2024 年 7 月 1 日以后，对多数房东来说，押金最多一个月: The California Attorney General says that after July 1, 2024, for most landlords the security deposit is limited to one month's rent. A deposit may only cover past-due rent, repairs of damage by tenants or guests (not ordinary wear and tear), cleaning back to move-in condition, and replacing the landlord's furnishings if the lease allows it.
加州法院自助中心写明：搬出后 21 天内，房东要退还全部押金，或退还余款并附上逐: California Courts self-help says that within 21 days of move-out the landlord must return the whole deposit, or the rest with an itemized statement; deductions over $125 need invoices or receipts, and work the landlord did personally must list the work, the time and the hourly rate. If repairs are not done within 21 days for a good reason, the landlord may send a good-faith estimate and then the receipts within 14 days of the repair.
保存租约、押金收据、入住与搬出照片、钥匙交接日期和转寄地址。: Keep the lease, deposit receipt, move-in and move-out photos, the key handover date and your forwarding address.
收到扣款清单后逐项对照：哪项是正常损耗，哪项附了发票或收据。: Go through the deduction list line by line: what is normal wear and tear, and which lines have invoices or receipts.
谈不拢时，先写信要求退还押金并留底；再到小额法庭起诉，租客最多可诉 $12,50: If you can't agree, write a letter asking for the deposit and keep a copy; then you can sue in small claims court, where a tenant can claim up to $12,500.
法院认定房东恶意扣押时，除押金外最多还可判两倍押金的赔偿。: If the court finds the deposit was kept in bad faith, it can add damages of up to twice the deposit.
催款信、证据准备和小额法庭步骤。: Demand letters, evidence and small claims steps.
维修：先留记录，再问当地处理渠道: Repairs: document the problem and ask local agencies
漏水、电路、供暖等安全问题，先拍照并书面告知房东，记下回复和处理日期。没解决就打: For leaks, wiring, heating or other safety problems, take photos, tell the landlord in writing and note the replies and dates. If it isn't fixed, call your city's code enforcement, building or health department. Talk to legal aid before withholding rent: stopping payment on your own can lead to an eviction case.
身份歧视与普通押金纠纷，找不同的入口: Discrimination and ordinary deposit disputes need different help
因族裔、国籍、家庭状况、残障等受保护身份受到住房歧视、报复，或要申请合理便利，找: For housing discrimination or retaliation because of race, national origin, family status, disability or another protected trait, or to request a reasonable accommodation, contact the Civil Rights Department (CRD, 800-884-1684). Ordinary deposit, repair or rent disputes are not CRD's; take those to your local rent agency, a court self-help center or legal aid.

收到驱逐相关法院文件时，当天找帮助: Seek help the day you receive eviction court documents
逐页保存通知和法院文件，记下收到的方式、日期和文件上的期限。加州司法部提醒：驱逐: Keep every page of each notice and court paper, and note how and when it arrived and the deadline it gives. The Attorney General warns that evictions move fast and missing a deadline can lose the case. Contact legal aid or a court self-help center the same day. Tenants covered by the Tenant Protection Act (TPA) can only be evicted for just cause after 12 months in the unit; your city or county may add more protection.
